column14: Having to interpret an extremely ambiguous value like "x" as another like "train_loss" is something really annoying, but it's usually not too troublesome once you ask around and figure out what "x" means. On the positive side, I found many of these logging smells really interesting. It's a trending topic that nobody talks about, and many ML researchers don't think of these as actual issues but things that they get used to because the codebase allows it. I hope that your research is great, and I hope that my answers are useful! :)
